The horse has a reddish-brown coat with white markings (socks) on its lower legs and a flaxen mane and tail. There is visible text overlay in the top right corner ('© Izzah...') and bottom right corner (gibberish/watermark style).

The neck displays a natural arch and muscular definition consistent with an athletic horse.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Uniform brownish-orange to light chestnut coat coloration with no black points.

The thoracic region appears deep and the topline is strong and level.
The tail is long, attached correctly, and shows individual hair strands.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Long slender legs with single hoof per foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All four legs are visible, structurally sound, and end in single hooves. No extra limbs or fusion detected.

Slight softness/blurring where the hooves meet the dirt, lacking sharp shadow definition, though not catastrophic.
